goal: Keep DC-Agent plugin ownership explicit so AstrBot adapters stay thin, reusable business logic lives in dc_engines/harness/dc_router, and runtime data never hides under plugin source trees.

acceptance_criteria.description: High-risk DC-Agent plugins have machine-readable roles, boundary status, adapter entrypoints, responsibilities, engine owners, config paths, and runtime data patterns.
Registered runtime data patterns stay outside data/plugins so source plugins remain commit-safe while local data is governed by repository hygiene checks.

roles.core_adapter: Bridge code that adapts AstrBot to an external runtime or core execution path.
roles.runtime_gateway: Routing or provider gateway code that controls execution selection and telemetry.
roles.product_plugin: User-facing business entrypoint whose reusable logic should live in dc_engines or harness.
roles.ops_plugin: Operator/admin surface for review, rollback, health, or dashboard workflows.

boundary_status.thin_adapter: Plugin mostly adapts AstrBot events/cards/commands to reusable engine modules.
boundary_status.mixed: Plugin has an engine boundary but still owns meaningful orchestration or policy.
boundary_status.plugin_heavy: Reusable business behavior still lives mostly inside data/plugins and should be extracted later.
boundary_status.runtime_service: Plugin owns a long-running bridge, callback, or execution service boundary.
